title: Computing the Hamiltonian compression factors of cubic graphs
summary: We present an algorithm for computing Hamiltonian cycles that are invariant under a graph automorphism acting on them as a rotation. We also present an application of this algorithm for computing the Hamiltonian compression factor of a graph, that is, the largest order of an automorphism preserving some Hamiltonian cycle and acting on it as a rotation. As an example, we compute the Hamiltonian compression factors of all cubic edge-transitive graphs on up to $10{,}000$ vertices, with the exception of two graphs, which are not Hamiltonian, and $98$ graphs (the smallest having $2304$ vertices)…
